Archive recovery and bounded physical-read preprocessing

Original encoded archive recovery remains blocked. The README inside the mirrored input container explicitly says that the Amazon gift card was removed and can be revealed by decoding. Thus the container is knowingly incomplete relative to the original encoded payload. Original git history, the release page and the Zenodo article deposit supply no encoded archive. Primary bioRxiv text specifies 2,146,816 bytes and 67,088 chunks, supporting the decoder geometry while leaving the conflicting README truncate command unresolved. No tested container truncation or padding convention matches the expected MD5. No nested archive was extracted or executed.

A separately frozen fallback inspected physical sequencing reads without payload decoding. Exactly 8 MiB of compressed bytes from each ERR1816980 master-pool mate were downloaded via verified HTTP 206 ranges. The incomplete gzip prefixes contain 92,414 and 86,355 complete FASTQ records; terminal partial records were excluded. Prefix SHA256 hashes are retained separately from the full-file ENA MD5 values. The first 10,000 synchronized pairs, each with 151nt mates, were inspected. This deterministic prefix is not a random sample or a whole-library error-rate estimate.

Strict exact-overlap stitching with a minimum of 20nt yields 6,368 stitched pairs and 3,632 no-match pairs. It deliberately differs from PEAR quality-aware stitching and may reject pairs that PEAR accepts. Of the stitched sequences, 5,278 have length 152nt. Ten contain non-ACGT symbols; 395 fail exact RS2 codeword checking; 4,873 pass. These records have 4,677 distinct seeds and 4,677 distinct sequence hashes. The test uses A=0, C=1, G=2, T=3 with four bases per byte and reedsolo 1.7.0 decode/re-encode equality. It does not reproduce the original unpinned software environment.

No GC or homopolymer screen, soliton mapping, fountain peeling or whole-payload decoding was performed. RS admissibility alone does not establish original source identity, full receiver acceptance, reconstruction or physical validation of the modified local codec. Code, range headers and digests, counts and selected-record hashes are retained in experiments/dna_fountain_bounded_read_audit.py and results/dna_fountain_bounded_read_audit.json. Full compressed sequencing data are not redistributed. The content-page gate remains uncertified.

Sources: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/074237v4.full-text ; https://github.com/TeamErlich/dna-fountain/releases ; https://zenodo.org/records/889697 . Exact source file URLs are in the result prefix ledger.
